mods.name: MegaHoe
mods.description: Hoe tool overhaul — level/reset terrain, height limit bypass, and configurable radius

mods.name: MegaMegingjord
mods.description: Megingjord belt powers — carry weight, headlamp, swamp key, sealbreaker, wishbone, seafloor walk

mods.name: MegaFood
mods.description: MegaFood + MegaMead — 150 HP/Stam/Eitr food, 14 toggleable mead effects, configurable duration. MegaMead Base is brewed at the Mead Ketil.

mods.name: MegaShot
mods.description: Crossbow & firearms overhaul — scope w/ Night/Heat/NightToDay vision modes (N) + creature labels, Armageddon OneShot meteor-slam

mods.name: MegaQoL
mods.description: Quality of life — auto repair, refueller, ballista, map teleport, quicker portals, no mist, instant mining, Shield Generator bubble/prong toggles, Warden (active Wards make build pieces + plantables in radius immune to damage), and Tamed Spike Immunity (your own Sharp Stakes, Ashwood Stakewall and Dvergr Sharp Stakes no longer skewer your tamed animals; wild mobs still cop it). Tamed Range (16, default off): widens Valheim's active-zone radius so your tamed creatures stay simulated and interactive (follow/react/move) much further from you instead of freezing once you wander off — ActiveZoneRadius 2-4 (~128/192/256m). Global setting that keeps other nearby objects and creatures simulated further too, so it carries a CPU/RAM cost near busy bases. Ballista now holds fire without a clear line of sight to its target, plus optional infinite Flametal-Bolt ammo and an optional MegaShot-Armageddon firing animation (Staff-of-Lightning bolt + meteor-crash on impact). MegaShot's ALT-fire destroy bolt can bypass the Warden to clear protected objects in the way (toggle in 12. Warden). Boat Map Reveal (17, on by default): while you're aboard a Raft, Karve, Longship or Drakkar, the map's fog-of-war uncovers a much larger area around you so sailing scouts the world (RevealMultiplier, ~8x by default). Build Dust Removal & Rune Build live in MegaBuilder v1.5.0+; auto-prunes orphan config sections on launch. — v1.18.0 MOVED the Home Portal network out to the standalone MegaPortals mod (install that to keep it; your hubs and settings carry over automatically) and REMOVED Quicker Portals. NEW Skill Tracker (19, on by default): Shift+Click any skill in the vanilla Skills panel to pin it to a compact permanent readout tucked under the minimap — icon, name, level, the vanilla +N food/gear bonus, and a thin bar for progress towards the next level. Shift+Click again to unpin; a gold star marks what's pinned in the panel and your picks persist across relogs. Configurable modifier key, optional show/hide hotkey, up to 20 rows, plus scale and pixel offsets if you want it parked somewhere else.

mods.name: MegaStuff
mods.description: Storage — quick deposit (respects AzuEPI extra rows), chest auto-pickup (loose food pulled, items on stands/Serving Tray spared), configurable chest sizes (up to 8 rows), Cart + Boat storage (Raft/Karve/Longship/Drakkar) configurable too, craft from containers, pet feeder, ALT+click ignore-from-deposit with visible lock badge (bottom-right), blocks Place Stacks too, SHIFT+drag chest windows, AzuEPI Extra Rows cap bumped 5→8, auto-prunes orphan config sections on launch. Chest deposit sparkle now fires once per chest (not once per item in a big dump), lingers longer (Speed config), and the sound is toggleable. Pet Feeder can now also feed and tame UNTAMED creatures from chests (FeedUntamed toggle, default on). Leave-1 rule: crafting, requireOnlyOne crafting, and the Pet Feeder always keep at least 1 of each item type in a chest so it stays a valid auto-deposit target — no more draining the last wood to craft or pets emptying a food chest. v1.5.0 — auto-pickup routing rules: treasure (coins, amber, amber pearl, ruby, silver necklace) always comes to you and is never claimed by a chest (the auto-store hotkey still deposits it), while loose food, mead and anything harvested from a Pickable gives nearby chests first claim — tray/stand food still stays put. Player pull is now duration-based like the chest tween instead of vanilla's flat 15 m/s crawl, so a wide pickup radius reels in fast (PlayerPullDuration, default 0.55s vs the chest 0.4s). Personal Chests you built now count as storage everywhere: auto-pickup, quick deposit, craft-from-containers and combined counts. v1.5.1 — chest priority now covers EVERY item except the PlayerFirstItems treasure list (ChestFirstCategories defaults to All, existing configs migrated), and the pickup window now widens with your travel speed so items no longer hover around you while flying or sailing instead of dropping into the pack. v1.5.4 - performance: mass crop harvest no longer freezes the game. Each deposited item was serialising the whole chest to the ZDO twice; now it's one write per chest per frame, with a 24-deposits-per-frame budget so a burst can't stall a single frame. Debug log strings are no longer built when DebugMode is off, and the craft-from-containers item count is cached instead of walking every nearby chest on every call. v1.5.5 — new Pull to Player/Chests toggle ([10. Pickup Rules] PullToChests, default Chests): decides where every automatic item pull lands. Chests keeps today’s behaviour — a nearby chest holding a stack of the item gets first claim; Player flips it so nothing is diverted to a chest and the periodic chest sweep leaves alone anything within your own pickup radius. Treasure (PlayerFirstItems) still always comes to you and a manual E-press is always yours.

mods.name: MegaFarming
mods.description: Mass farming — hold-key mass harvest pickables/beehives, grid plant any cultivator plant (plants need just one build-grid cell of room to grow - 0.25m for crops, 0.5m for trees, straight off MegaBuilder's 0.25/0.5/1/2/4m ladder - so anything you plant on the grid actually grows instead of sitting on 'lacking space', per-cell cultivated-ground check), plant anywhere (any biome), plus custom plantables (bushes, mushrooms, thistle, fiddleheads, royal jelly) added to the Cultivator. Middle-click a crop while holding the Cultivator to remove it, growth + respawn timer hover (saplings AND picked berry bushes / mushrooms etc.), stump markers on picked renewables.

mods.name: MegaFishing
mods.description: Fish auto-pull into containers, boats and carts, with container-first pickup, quality upgrade and configurable radius

mods.name: MegaFactory
mods.description: Smart factory: same-type stations sharing nearby chests form a cluster and auto-divide the work - drop 4 smelters next to Tin/Copper/Silver/Iron and they each pick one ore, blast furnaces split Black Metal/Flametal, no work orders needed (SmartDistribution config, default on - toggle off for manual work orders). Spare stations double up on the busiest stockpile; surplus stations are idled so output can't overfill storage. Manual work orders now alternate (round-robin) between multiple loaded orders so every metal progresses together instead of finishing one before the next (AlternateWorkOrders config, default on). Smelter & Blast Furnace now show what's currently loaded per ore - on hover and in the Shift+E work-order panel. Auto-feeds Kiln/Smelter/Blast Furnace/Windmill/Spinning Wheel/Eitr Refinery in the background regardless of player distance, leaves 1 of each item type per container. With MegaStuff pull-to-chest on, stations freeze when output storage is full and auto-resume when space frees.

mods.name: MegaTrainer
mods.description: In-game cheat trainer — god mode, fly, no cost, explore map, always rested, infinite eitr, tame all, no structure damage, fast skill up, speed/jump controls

mods.name: MegaBuilder
mods.description: Rotation-aware decorative snap (sconces/torches/signs centre on rotated walls), grid-align respects vanilla snap on structural pieces (rotated floors line up cleanly), 0.25/0.5/1/2/4m grid sizes for open-ground placement, build-dust removal, rune-build (bypass no-build zones), ALT+click hammer radius-repair (1-100m, default 10m), plus new no-collision placement (clip pieces into terrain/other pieces/players, off by default) and dungeon build (place inside dungeons/interiors, off by default); auto-prunes orphan config sections on launch; furniture snaps to the piece you point at, including angled/octagon builds.

mods.name: MegaSkeletons
mods.description: Summoned skeleton buffs (health, speed, HoT, line-of-sight) + portal/dungeon persistence + remote skeleton detonator (AOE explosion + housefire damaging hostiles, trees, rocks and world structures — player builds & pickables spared)

mods.name: MegaDvergr
mods.description: Tameable Dvergr companions — wild-tame the five variants (Dvergr Rogue, DvergerAshlands, and the Ice/Fire/Support mages) by feeding cooked food only (Cauldron/Oven/Prep Table/Cooking stations); pairs with MegaStuff's Pet Feeder (FeedUntamed) to tame from a stocked chest. The Dead Raiser staff now summons a tamed dvergr warband instead of skeletons, one-of-each scaled by staff level (Ashlands → +Ice → +Fire → +Support, 2-star), topped up on each cast.

mods.name: MegaPlanner
mods.description: Capture every built piece within a configurable radius into a JSON blueprint (F9 default), then re-place the entire structure later from a menu (F10 default). Replay HUD shows the full running material budget with proper localised names (have/need per material). Free Build option (config + auto-engages with MegaTrainer's no_placement_cost cheat) skips materials entirely. Ghost is independent of the player — walk freely with WASD/mouse, manipulate the ghost with arrow keys: Left/Right rotate, Up/Down raise/lower (Shift = fast), Alt+arrows nudge XZ in your view direction. Mousewheel-zoom placement camera (close third-person <-> godview), R resets zoom, Home resets ghost offsets. Live 3D preview in the menu, paced placement, pulls materials from inventory + nearby chests. Food, meads and loose items (armour/weapons/trophies) are excluded from blueprints by default so a replay builds the structure only - opt each back in with the IncludeFood / IncludeMeads / IncludeItems toggles.

mods.name: MegaDragons
mods.description: Tameable, near-unkillable companion dragons. Wild-tame Mountain Hatchlings (Drakes) with raw meat (ground or MegaStuff Pet Feeder); tamed Drakes follow/stay, keep up with you at a sprint or in the air, spot threats from afar, pack 10,000 HP + elemental immunity, heal when they eat, and auto-defend you. Crouch + interact to name your dragon (each starts with a random dragon name). One dragon at a time. Craft a Dragon Whistle to call your dragon down beside you from anywhere in the world (G, or equip + click), or release it to raise a new one. RIDE & FLY: craft a Dragon Saddle (Workbench lvl 4), fit it, and mount up — a visible saddle appears on the dragon's back, and you get true 360-degree look-to-fly (aim anywhere, even straight up or down), sprint, altitude control and auto-hover. While mounted, the map's fog-of-war reveals a huge area around you as you fly. TWO WEAPONS: Left Click fires the dragon's cold-ball shots (and it still auto-attacks nearby threats hands-free), while ALT + LEFT CLICK swaps to the real DRAGON BREATH — a sustained 30m cone of frost out of the jaw, Moder's own attack, complete with her frost plume. FLIGHT HUD: a fighter-jet head-up display while you fly — a pitch ladder of flight level lines on the true horizon, a flight path marker showing where you're really going, altitude with height-above-ground and climb rate, speed, and a compass heading strip. Space and Ctrl now lift and drop the dragon straight up and down instead of drifting forward. GROW A MODER: build Dragon Food at a Food Preparation Table with the Feaster and place it beside your tamed Hatchling — it feasts serving-by-serving and matures into a tamed, rideable Moder that keeps its name, owner, level and saddle.

mods.name: MegaDebug
mods.description: Floating diagnostic mod — on-demand probes (managed-heap/ZDO/object counters + ZDO census) for debugging game issues. Install to diagnose, remove when done. All output gated by [99. Debug] DebugMode.

mods.name: MiniQoL
mods.description: Standalone replacement for parts of the Mega series — do NOT run it alongside MegaBuilder, MegaFarming or MegaMegingjord, as it re-implements their features and would double-patch the same methods. (MegaPortals is fine to run with it.) Bundles: build-piece grid snap (F7 toggles, F6 cycles 0.25/0.5/1/2/4m, furniture snaps to the piece you point at including angled/octagon builds); mass farming (hold the hotkey to mass-harvest pickables, pickable-items and beehives within radius, or grid-plant a configurable WxL block, with FarmGridSize where 0 follows the F6 build grid and spacing auto-widens so bushes never overlap); and Sea Floor Walking (press Minus [-] to stop swimming and walk the ocean floor — hotkey only, no Megingjord belt or gear needed, and the camera stops clipping above the waterline). — v1.5.0 MOVED the Home Portal network out to the standalone MegaPortals mod; install that to keep it. Your hubs and your Home Portal settings carry over automatically. Renamed from FarmBuild in v1.4.0.

mods.name: MegaPortals
mods.description: Hub-and-spoke portal teleport network. Build a stone "Home Portal Hub" from the Hammer (Misc tab) and name it, e.g. "home", then name your ordinary portals "home>Label" to link them as spokes. Walk into a spoke to travel to its hub; walk into the hub to pick a destination from a sortable Name/Biome/Distance table — click a header to sort, hub pinned top, names sort symbols before digits before letters, and the biome shows for every destination on the map (not just loaded zones). SpokeToSpoke lets spokes reach sibling spokes directly. PortalNameMaxLength raises vanilla's 10-character portal name cap. Configurable hub build cost. — This feature MOVED here out of MegaQoL (v1.18.0) and MiniQoL (v1.5.0); update those at the same time or two mods will patch the same portal methods. Hubs you have already built keep working: MegaPortals registers the legacy MegaQoL_PortalHub and FarmBuild_PortalHub prefab names alongside its own, and adopts your existing Home Portal settings on first run.

mods.name: MegaArrow
mods.description: Volley arrow for any bow. Craft 100 at the Workbench (10 Wood, 10 Feathers, 1 Freeze Gland, 1 Ooze, 1 Resin, 1 Obsidian). Loose one and it becomes one homing arrow per enemy in your forward cone, up to 10 (crows and gulls included, perched or in flight — TargetBirds toggle) — target 1 is the creature under your crosshair and is the arrow you fired; the rest each wear a different vanilla arrow's look (Frost, Poison, Fire, Needle, Obsidian, Silver, Charred, Carapace, Iron, Bronze — or shuffled every shot with RandomiseArrowLooks). All or nothing: if your aimed arrow strikes a creature every extra arrow lands, if it misses they all miss. Every arrow deals TotalDamage (100) split evenly across the enabled types — Pierce, Blunt, Slash, Fire, Frost, Lightning, Poison, Spirit, all on by default — with vanilla burn/poison/spirit DoT, frost slow and lightning effects. Configurable cone, range, line-of-sight gate, homing turn rate and per-type toggles; live config reload.

mods.name: MegaCommander
mods.description: Admin and dev console commands — devcommands, aliases, key binds, autocomplete and server tooling (fork of JereKuusela's Server Devcommands)
